name: dialog
purpose: Modal surface above the page, built on the shared Panel shell. `Dialog.Content` is the whole modal: it teleports to `body`, renders the dimmed overlay behind the panel, traps focus and scroll-locks the page, so the page behind cannot be clicked, scrolled or tabbed to while the dialog is open. The consumer composes a trigger and the panel regions (header, body, footer); the header gets the close (X) button on its own unless `closable` is false; the body is the only region that scrolls. Below `md` it renders as a full-width bottom sheet.
useWhen: A focused, blocking modal task or confirmation that should sit centered over the page and trap focus.
The interaction must be completed or dismissed before returning to the page.
avoidWhen: The content is a side panel or a long form that should slide from an edge, over the screen that owns it → use `drawer` (nothing inside a drawer navigates; a destination of its own is a page).
It is small contextual content anchored to a trigger (a menu, info bubble, picker) → use a popover / `dropdown-menu`.
related: `drawer` — edge-anchored panel for secondary tasks / long content.
bestPractices: Do not add an overlay, a portal or a close button by hand: `Dialog.Content` renders the overlay and the portal, and the header renders the close button while `closable` is true (the default). Set `:closable="false"` only when the dialog must be answered through its footer actions.
While an action is in flight, set `:dismissible="false"` and `:closable="false"` together so neither Escape, the overlay nor the close button can close it.
One clear primary action; keep the body scannable.

Bind the open state with `v-model:open`, or `:open` plus an `@update:open` handler typed `(open: boolean) => void`. The payload is always a `boolean`, so the handler needs no cast and no `Boolean(...)`.

props.name: closable
props.doc: Shows the close (X) button at the end of the dialog header. False removes it; Escape and overlay click still follow `dismissible`.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Light-dismiss: when true, overlay click and Escape close the dialog. It does not govern the close button; see `closable`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Panel max-width preset passed to the inner Panel.
